Erin York Cornwell is a postdoctoral research associate in the Department of Sociology at Cornell University. She was the project coordinator for the first wave of the National Social Life, Health, and Aging Project (NSHAP), which provided the data for this article. She is interested in how social context and social relationships shape individuals' life chances.
